description: Second, structurally-different query per gold record. The golden test asserts gold and verify agree on the fixture. Not shipped in the suite; this is the independence-check artifact.

verify_sql.sales-001: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) - (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE channel <> 'phone' OR channel IS NULL);
verify_sql.sales-002: SELECT round(sum(t), 2) FROM (SELECT status, sum(total_amount) t FROM orders GROUP BY status) s;
verify_sql.sales-003: SELECT round((SELECT sum(salary) FROM employees) / (SELECT count(*) FROM employees), 2);
verify_sql.sales-004: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category;
verify_sql.sales-005: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM products) - (SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE discontinued = false);
verify_sql.sales-006: SELECT price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;
verify_sql.sales-007: SELECT p.category, round(sum(x.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM (SELECT product_id, sum(line_total) rev FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) x JOIN products p ON p.id = x.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-008: SELECT m.name AS manager, (SELECT count(*) FROM employees e WHERE e.manager_id = m.id) AS reports FROM employees m WHERE m.id IN (SELECT manager_id FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY reports DESC;
verify_sql.sales-009: SELECT r.name AS region, (SELECT round(avg(lead_time_days), 2) FROM suppliers s WHERE s.region_id = r.id) AS avg_lead_days FROM regions r WHERE r.id IN (SELECT region_id FROM suppliers WHERE region_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY avg_lead_days;
verify_sql.sales-010: SELECT b.name AS brand, (SELECT count(*) FROM products p WHERE p.brand_id = b.id) AS products FROM brands b WHERE b.id IN (SELECT brand_id FROM products WHERE brand_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY products DESC;
verify_sql.sales-011: SELECT w.name AS warehouse, x.units FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, sum(quantity) units FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id) x JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = x.warehouse_id ORDER BY x.units DESC;
verify_sql.sales-012: SELECT pm.name AS method, (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_method_id = pm.id) AS total FROM payment_methods pm WHERE pm.id IN (SELECT payment_method_id FROM payments WHERE payment_method_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY total DESC;
verify_sql.sales-013: SELECT e.name AS rep, (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.employee_id = e.id) AS orders FROM employees e WHERE e.id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM orders WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY orders DESC;
verify_sql.sales-014: SELECT lt.name AS tier, (SELECT count(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.loyalty_tier_id = lt.id) AS customers FROM loyalty_tiers lt WHERE lt.id IN (SELECT loyalty_tier_id FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY customers DESC;
verify_sql.sales-015: SELECT t.name AS tag, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_tags pt WHERE pt.tag_id = t.id) AS products FROM tags t WHERE t.id IN (SELECT tag_id FROM product_tags) ORDER BY products DESC;
verify_sql.sales-016: SELECT c.code AS coupon, (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.coupon_id = c.id) AS uses FROM coupons c WHERE c.id IN (SELECT coupon_id FROM orders WHERE coupon_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY uses DESC;
verify_sql.sales-017: SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(x.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM (SELECT customer_id, sum(total_amount) rev FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) x JOIN customers c ON c.id = x.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-018: SELECT s.name AS supplier, round(sum(j.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM (SELECT ps.supplier_id, x.rev FROM product_suppliers ps JOIN (SELECT product_id, sum(line_total) rev FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) x ON x.product_id = ps.product_id) j JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = j.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-019: SELECT pr.name AS promotion, (SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM order_promotions op JOIN orders o ON o.id = op.order_id WHERE op.promotion_id = pr.id) AS revenue FROM promotions pr WHERE pr.id IN (SELECT promotion_id FROM order_promotions) ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-020: SELECT t.name AS tag, round(sum(x.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM tags t JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id JOIN (SELECT product_id, sum(line_total) rev FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) x ON x.product_id = pt.product_id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-021: SELECT tm.name AS team, round(sum(x.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM teams tm JOIN employee_teams et ON et.team_id = tm.id JOIN (SELECT employee_id, sum(total_amount) rev FROM orders GROUP BY employee_id) x ON x.employee_id = et.employee_id GROUP BY tm.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-022: SELECT b.name AS brand, (SELECT round(avg(rv.rating), 2) FROM reviews rv JOIN products p ON p.id = rv.product_id WHERE p.brand_id = b.id) AS avg_rating FROM brands b WHERE b.id IN (SELECT p.brand_id FROM reviews rv JOIN products p ON p.id = rv.product_id WHERE p.brand_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;
verify_sql.sales-023: SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Europe') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-024: SELECT co.name AS country, (SELECT count(*) FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.country_id = co.id) AS customers FROM countries co WHERE co.id IN (SELECT country_id FROM regions WHERE country_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY customers DESC;
verify_sql.sales-025: SELECT ca.name AS carrier, sum(x.units) AS units FROM shipments s JOIN carriers ca ON ca.id = s.carrier_id JOIN (SELECT shipment_id, sum(quantity) units FROM shipment_items GROUP BY shipment_id) x ON x.shipment_id = s.id GROUP BY ca.name ORDER BY units DESC;
verify_sql.sales-026: SELECT p.category, round(sum(x.amt), 2) AS refunded FROM (SELECT return_id, sum(amount) amt FROM refunds GROUP BY return_id) x JOIN returns rt ON rt.id = x.return_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refunded DESC;
verify_sql.sales-027: SELECT sc.name AS subcategory, sum(x.units) AS units FROM (SELECT product_id, sum(quantity) units FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id) x JOIN products p ON p.id = x.product_id JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = p.subcategory_id GROUP BY sc.name ORDER BY units DESC;
verify_sql.sales-028: SELECT b.name AS brand, sum(x.units) AS units FROM (SELECT product_id, sum(quantity) units FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) x JOIN products p ON p.id = x.product_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY units DESC;
verify_sql.sales-029: SELECT round(sum(t), 2) FROM (SELECT status, sum(total_amount) t FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '30 days' FROM orders) GROUP BY status) s;
verify_sql.sales-030: SELECT date_trunc('month', d.day)::date AS month, round(sum(d.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM (SELECT order_date AS day, sum(total_amount) rev FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '6 months' FROM orders) GROUP BY order_date) d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
verify_sql.sales-031: SELECT 'last_12m' AS period, round((SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '12 months' FROM orders)), 2) AS revenue UNION ALL SELECT 'prior_12m', round((SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date <= (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '12 months' FROM orders) AND order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '24 months' FROM orders)), 2);
verify_sql.sales-032: SELECT 'latest_quarter' AS period, round((SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '90 days' FROM orders)), 2) AS revenue UNION ALL SELECT 'prior_quarter', round((SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date <= (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '90 days' FROM orders) AND order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '180 days' FROM orders)), 2);
verify_sql.sales-033: SELECT date_trunc('month', d.day)::date AS month, sum(d.c) AS signups FROM (SELECT signed_up_at::date AS day, count(*) c FROM customers WHERE signed_up_at > (SELECT max(signed_up_at) - interval '12 months' FROM customers) GROUP BY signed_up_at::date) d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
verify_sql.sales-034: SELECT round(avg(c), 2) FROM (SELECT order_date, count(*) c FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '30 days' FROM orders) GROUP BY order_date) d;
verify_sql.sales-035: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', m.mth)::date AS quarter, sum(m.c) AS orders FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) mth, count(*) c FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '12 months' FROM orders) GROUP BY 1) m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
verify_sql.sales-036: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '90 days' FROM orders)) / (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) - interval '90 days' FROM orders)), 2);
verify_sql.sales-038: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Enterprise') / (SELECT count(*) FROM customers), 2);
verify_sql.sales-039: SELECT round((SELECT sum(line_total) FROM order_items)::numeric / (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM order_items), 2);
verify_sql.sales-040: SELECT category, round(100.0 * rev / sum(rev) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM (SELECT p.category, sum(oi.line_total) rev FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category) t ORDER BY pct DESC;
verify_sql.sales-041: SELECT round(avg(margin), 2) FROM (SELECT (price - cost) / price * 100 AS margin FROM products WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND price > 0) t;
verify_sql.sales-042: SELECT round(avg(c), 2) FROM (SELECT employee_id, count(*) c FROM orders WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employee_id) t;
verify_sql.sales-043: SELECT name, spend FROM (SELECT c.name, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) spend, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(o.total_amount) DESC, c.name) rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name) t WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY spend DESC, name;
verify_sql.sales-044: SELECT name, units FROM (SELECT p.name, sum(oi.quantity) units, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC, p.name) rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name) t WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY units DESC, name;
verify_sql.sales-045: SELECT category, revenue FROM (SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) revenue, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(oi.line_total) DESC) rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-046: SELECT region, revenue FROM (SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(o.total_amount) DESC) rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name) t ORDER BY rn;
verify_sql.sales-047: SELECT p.name, count(*) AS review_count FROM reviews rv JOIN products p ON p.id = rv.product_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING count(*) >= (SELECT min(c) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT count(*) c FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5) d) ORDER BY review_count DESC, name;
verify_sql.sales-048: SELECT a.segment, a.total - COALESCE(d.deleted, 0) AS customers FROM (SELECT segment, count(*) total FROM customers GROUP BY segment) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT segment, count(*) deleted FROM customers WHERE is_deleted GROUP BY segment) d ON d.segment = a.segment ORDER BY customers DESC;
verify_sql.sales-049: SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(x.rev), 2) AS revenue FROM (SELECT customer_id, sum(total_amount) rev FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY customer_id) x JOIN customers c ON c.id = x.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
verify_sql.sales-050: SELECT status, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status IN ('pending', 'shipped') GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC;
